classification_definitions.CLEAN_ALLOWLISTED: Clean only for the stated narrow governance or feasibility purpose; it does not authorize scientific execution or transitive access.
classification_definitions.QUARANTINED: Contains subject-derived data, fitted parameters, search results, outcome metrics, or raw-data locators that cannot be released to scientific roles.
classification_definitions.UNRESOLVED: No decisive outcome contamination was found in the inspected metadata, but exact provenance or code-version linkage is absent.
classification_definitions.DENIED: Opening or using the exact file would necessarily consume a protected or excluded payload. No candidate exact file required this class; manifest-referenced payloads are separately denied and unopened.

common_prohibitions: No raw-signal, EDF/PSG, hypnogram, or manifest-referenced path opening.
No parameter, score, metric, threshold, sweep result, or array-value disclosure to scientific roles.
No execution, model fitting, ranking, winner selection, or cleanliness/access inheritance.
No R4 identity or Night-1 status inference from filenames, subject suffixes, paths, or content similarity.

cross_file_findings.sleep_stage_context: The parallel exact sets epochs_[n1,n2,n3,rem,wake].csv and psd_[n1,n2,n3,rem,wake].npy, together with the absence of any night column, establish n1/n2/n3 as sleep-stage labels in this local context. They do not certify recording nights.

certification.reason: No inspected exact file contains an authoritative public/development designation plus a Night-1 field or certification. Subject suffixes, filenames, and manifest path strings are not certification.

r4_candidate_identity.reason: No R4 candidate identifier, exact R4 source path, or approved R4-to-current hash binding appears in the inspected controls or exact data metadata. R4 trees were not opened or searched.

phase_2b_multi_subject_feasibility.reason: The current clean release provides a 153-subject index and a 10-subject stage-denominator subset, but only one subject token is represented by personalized parameter artifacts, none is clean for execution, and no subject is explicitly certified public/development Night-1. Producing additional personalized models would require denied raw PSG/hypnogram access or a new clean external release.
